δεδμημένος: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — overpower, subdue; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’ (by sleep)
οὔδεϊ: οὖδας — ground, floor; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= οὔδει)
πλῆτο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. mid./pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπλήσθη): ’was filled’ (+ gen.)
προτέρη: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’first, before (him)’, Ionic η (= Attic προτέρα)
πρώτιστος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., epic double superlative πρώτιστος: ’the very first’
σκηπτόμενον: σκήπτομαι — lean on, support oneself on; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’leaning (on a staff)’
χεῦαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔχεαν); with κατά in tmesis: ’poured down’
ἀλκτῆρα: ἀλκτήρ — defender, one who wards off (+ gen.); masc. acc. sg.
ἀπειλάων: ἀπειλή — threat; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ἀρῆς: ἀρά — prayer (also curse, by context); fem. gen. sg.
ἐφίλει: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was fond of, cherished’
ἔξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen.; accented ἔξ because the enclitic εἰσι follows it: ’of (my stock)’
ἔσσυτ: σεύομαι — rush, hasten; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic, elided (ἔσσυτ’ = ἔσσυτο)
ἤνοπι: ἤνοψ — gleaming, flashing (of bronze; the sense is traditional, not certain); masc. dat. sg., formulaic epithet of bronze
ἤρατ: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); mid. win, gain for oneself; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἤρατ’ = ἤρατο): ’won’; in sense the aorist of ἄρνυμαι ’win’, under which some lexica file it
ὀφθαλμοῖο: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= -οῦ)
ὄπασσε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, send along; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὤπασε): ’gave’
ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, wherever, in whatever way; relative adv.
ὑπέμεινεν: ὑπομένω — stay behind, wait; aor. 3 sg.
